criteria.reason: Letter is written in Rumantsch Grischun throughout; minor garbled forms (Gnada, Cu, esserem) but no switch to German.
All key details present: booking request, concert purpose, 14 December, 17:00–19:00, plus polite availability inquiry.
Register is formal and courteous (respectful closing, polite phrasing), fitting a municipal authority despite language slips.

summary: Compliant: a short, formal, courteous letter in (imperfect) Rumantsch Grischun containing all booking details, without switching to German.
